coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); tick squares from ink at 400 dpi; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: A PIPE subscription agreement: the issuer and its shelf company each sign on page 25; the subscriber (and a joint subscriber if any) signs and gives registration, contact and amount details on page 26, then ticks the eligibility schedule (pages 27-28).

sure_per_page.25: sure of the two signature rules; name and title are captions with no line (judgement: places)
sure_per_page.26: sure of every rule, box and run; name, title and date in the two signature blocks are captions with no line (judgement: places)
sure_per_page.28: sure (eleven printed boxes; the "initialing" the text mentions has no printed place)
